# Generated by eu5autobuild.generator.
monthly_country_pulse = {
	on_actions = {
		eu5ab_monthly_country_policy_pulse
		eu5ab_governor_monthly_pulse_on_action
	}
}

eu5ab_monthly_country_policy_pulse = {
	effect = {
 eu5ab_manual_expire = yes
		# Close the old month before assessing the new month's independent quota.
		if = { limit = { is_human = yes } eu5ab_expire_old_scan_month = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_human = yes
				var:eu5ab_global_enabled > 0
				any_owned_location = { has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id }
				NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_active }
				NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_round_active }
				NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active }
				NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load }
			}
			# Scan the persisted buckets from day 2, use day 22 for deferred
			# locations, then finalize the construction queue from day 23.
			trigger_event_silently = {
				id = eu5ab_monthly.1
				days = 1
			}
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_governor_monthly_pulse_on_action = {
	effect = {
		eu5ab_governor_monthly_pulse = yes
	}
}

# Each location invocation is an independent task when the engine dispatches
# this events block. The worker event writes only to its root location.
eu5ab_parallel_location_scan_on_action = {
	events = {
		eu5ab_worker.1
	}
}

on_location_changed_owner = {
	on_actions = {
		eu5ab_on_location_changed_owner
		eu5ab_governor_dirty_from_owner_change_on_action
	}
}

eu5ab_governor_dirty_from_owner_change_on_action = {
	effect = {
		eu5ab_governor_dirty_from_owner_change = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_on_location_changed_owner = {
	effect = {
		eu5ab_remove_location_template_coverage = yes
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket }
			scope:loser ?= {
				switch = {
					trigger = root.var:eu5ab_scan_bucket
					1 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_1_locations target = root } }
					2 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_2_locations target = root } }
					3 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_3_locations target = root } }
					4 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_4_locations target = root } }
					5 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_5_locations target = root } }
					6 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_6_locations target = root } }
					7 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_7_locations target = root } }
					8 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_8_locations target = root } }
					9 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_9_locations target = root } }
					10 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_10_locations target = root } }
					11 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_11_locations target = root } }
					12 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_12_locations target = root } }
					13 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_13_locations target = root } }
					14 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_14_locations target = root } }
					15 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_15_locations target = root } }
					16 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_16_locations target = root } }
					17 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_17_locations target = root } }
					18 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_18_locations target = root } }
					19 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_19_locations target = root } }
					20 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_20_locations target = root } }
				}
			}
			remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id scope:winner ?= { is_human = yes } }
			eu5ab_register_location_for_scan = yes
		}
		eu5ab_sync_location_template_coverage = yes
	}
}

	on_actions = {

# CMF 2.4.1 copies CMM values when the player changes country, but a country
# created after the first global registration has no action-bar active list.
# Move EU5AB's player-facing registration to the new country and deactivate the
# old country without deleting its persistent templates or historical data.
cmf_on_country_transfer = {
	on_actions = {
		eu5ab_on_cmf_country_transfer
	}
}

eu5ab_on_cmf_country_transfer = {
	effect = {
 eu5ab_profile_transfer = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:old_country
				scope:old_country = {
					is_target_in_variable_list = {
						name = cmf_action_bar_active_elements
						target = flag:eu5ab_action_bar
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						is_target_in_variable_list = {
							name = cmf_action_bar_active_elements
							target = flag:eu5ab_action_bar
						}
					}
				}
				add_to_variable_list = {
					name = cmf_action_bar_active_elements
					target = flag:eu5ab_action_bar
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			remove_list_variable = {
				name = cmf_action_bar_active_elements
				target = flag:eu5ab_action_bar
			}
		}

		# Registration rebuilt the CMM action-bar rows before this callback.
		# Resync EU5AB's bool field after restoring the transferred active list.
		eu5ab_sync_cmf_action_bar_toggle = yes

		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:old_country NOT = { this ?= scope:old_country } }
			scope:old_country = {
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = cmf_action_bar_active_elements
					target = flag:eu5ab_action_bar
				}
				remove_list_variable = {
					name = cmm_registered_mod_ids
					target = flag:eu5ab_regional_development
				}
				remove_variable = eu5ab_cmf_window_requested
				eu5ab_recover_runtime_after_load = yes
				remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load
			}
		}
	}
}

# CMF dispatches action-bar clicks through a shared callback.
cmf_on_callback = {
	on_actions = {
		eu5ab_on_cmf_callback
	}
}

eu5ab_on_cmf_callback = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_local_governor_available_alert
					var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_local_governor_relocation_alert
					var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_naval_governor_available_alert
					var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_naval_governor_relocation_alert
				}
			}
			eu5ab_prepare_governor_window = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_action_bar }
			set_variable = eu5ab_cmf_window_requested
			remove_variable = eu5ab_active_preset_policy
			eu5ab_select_first_player_template = yes
		}
		# CMM auto-apply fires the same callback with the composite setting key.
		if = {
			limit = { var:cmf_callback != flag:eu5ab_action_bar }
			if = {
				limit = { var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__governor_refresh_now }
				eu5ab_governor_manual_recalculation = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__governor_recommendations_enabled
						var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__governor_relocation_enabled
						var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__governor_migration_enabled
						var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__governor_migration_threshold_percent
						var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__governor_refresh_interval
						var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__governor_scoring_profile
						var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__governor_strategic_value
					}
				}
				set_variable = eu5ab_governor_dirty
				if = { limit = { NOT = { var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__governor_migration_threshold_percent } } set_variable = eu5ab_naval_planner_dirty }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__performance_preset }
				switch = {
					trigger = "variable_map(cmm|flag:eu5ab_regional_development__performance_preset)"
					1 = {
						cmm_set_setting_value = { setting = eu5ab_regional_development__parallel_location_scan value = 1 }
						cmm_set_setting_value = { setting = eu5ab_regional_development__daily_location_task_limit value = 10 }
						cmm_set_setting_value = { setting = eu5ab_regional_development__max_additions_per_run value = 30 }
						cmm_set_setting_value = { setting = eu5ab_regional_development__candidates_per_location value = 5 }
						cmm_set_setting_value = { setting = eu5ab_regional_development__actual_profit_candidates_per_location value = 15 }
						cmm_set_setting_value = { setting = eu5ab_regional_development__early_stop_when_candidates_sufficient value = 1 }
					}
					2 = {
						cmm_set_setting_value = { setting = eu5ab_regional_development__parallel_location_scan value = 1 }
						cmm_set_setting_value = { setting = eu5ab_regional_development__daily_location_task_limit value = 20 }
						cmm_set_setting_value = { setting = eu5ab_regional_development__max_additions_per_run value = 50 }
						cmm_set_setting_value = { setting = eu5ab_regional_development__candidates_per_location value = 4 }
						cmm_set_setting_value = { setting = eu5ab_regional_development__actual_profit_candidates_per_location value = 12 }
						cmm_set_setting_value = { setting = eu5ab_regional_development__early_stop_when_candidates_sufficient value = 1 }
					}
					3 = {
						cmm_set_setting_value = { setting = eu5ab_regional_development__parallel_location_scan value = 1 }
						cmm_set_setting_value = { setting = eu5ab_regional_development__daily_location_task_limit value = 30 }
						cmm_set_setting_value = { setting = eu5ab_regional_development__max_additions_per_run value = 0 }
						cmm_set_setting_value = { setting = eu5ab_regional_development__candidates_per_location value = 3 }
						cmm_set_setting_value = { setting = eu5ab_regional_development__actual_profit_candidates_per_location value = 10 }
						cmm_set_setting_value = { setting = eu5ab_regional_development__early_stop_when_candidates_sufficient value = 1 }
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__parallel_location_scan
						var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__daily_location_task_limit
						var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__max_additions_per_run
						var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__candidates_per_location
						var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__actual_profit_candidates_per_location
						var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__early_stop_when_candidates_sufficient
					}
				}
				cmm_set_setting_value = { setting = eu5ab_regional_development__performance_preset value = 4 }
			}
			# CMM's stock Shift gesture jumps to min/max. Reinterpret those endpoint
			# writes as the larger step documented by this Mod's tooltips.
			if = {
				limit = { var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__monthly_build_hard_cap }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_monthly_build_hard_cap }
					if = {
						limit = { "variable_map(cmm|flag:eu5ab_regional_development__monthly_build_hard_cap)" = 599 var:eu5ab_monthly_build_hard_cap < 599 }
						set_variable = { name = eu5ab_cmm_shift_step value = { value = var:eu5ab_monthly_build_hard_cap add = 10 max = 599 } }
						cmm_set_setting_value = { setting = eu5ab_regional_development__monthly_build_hard_cap value = var:eu5ab_cmm_shift_step }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { "variable_map(cmm|flag:eu5ab_regional_development__monthly_build_hard_cap)" = 0 var:eu5ab_monthly_build_hard_cap > 0 }
						set_variable = { name = eu5ab_cmm_shift_step value = { value = var:eu5ab_monthly_build_hard_cap subtract = 10 min = 0 } }
						cmm_set_setting_value = { setting = eu5ab_regional_development__monthly_build_hard_cap value = var:eu5ab_cmm_shift_step }
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__fixed_annual_budget }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_global_fixed_annual_budget }
					if = {
						limit = { "variable_map(cmm|flag:eu5ab_regional_development__fixed_annual_budget)" = 999999 var:eu5ab_global_fixed_annual_budget < 999999 }
						set_variable = { name = eu5ab_cmm_shift_step value = { value = var:eu5ab_global_fixed_annual_budget add = 1000 max = 999999 } }
						cmm_set_setting_value = { setting = eu5ab_regional_development__fixed_annual_budget value = var:eu5ab_cmm_shift_step }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { "variable_map(cmm|flag:eu5ab_regional_development__fixed_annual_budget)" = 0 var:eu5ab_global_fixed_annual_budget > 0 }
						set_variable = { name = eu5ab_cmm_shift_step value = { value = var:eu5ab_global_fixed_annual_budget subtract = 1000 min = 0 } }
						cmm_set_setting_value = { setting = eu5ab_regional_development__fixed_annual_budget value = var:eu5ab_cmm_shift_step }
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__min_cash_reserve }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_global_min_cash_reserve }
					if = {
						limit = { "variable_map(cmm|flag:eu5ab_regional_development__min_cash_reserve)" = 100000 var:eu5ab_global_min_cash_reserve < 100000 }
						set_variable = { name = eu5ab_cmm_shift_step value = { value = var:eu5ab_global_min_cash_reserve add = 1000 max = 100000 } }
						cmm_set_setting_value = { setting = eu5ab_regional_development__min_cash_reserve value = var:eu5ab_cmm_shift_step }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { "variable_map(cmm|flag:eu5ab_regional_development__min_cash_reserve)" = 0 var:eu5ab_global_min_cash_reserve > 0 }
						set_variable = { name = eu5ab_cmm_shift_step value = { value = var:eu5ab_global_min_cash_reserve subtract = 1000 min = 0 } }
						cmm_set_setting_value = { setting = eu5ab_regional_development__min_cash_reserve value = var:eu5ab_cmm_shift_step }
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__governor_migration_threshold_percent }
				eu5ab_governor_adjust_threshold_step = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__naval_governor_migration_threshold_percent }
				eu5ab_naval_planner_adjust_threshold_step = yes
				set_variable = eu5ab_naval_planner_dirty
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__rgo_job_fill_deadline_months }
				eu5ab_rgo_adjust_horizon_step = yes
			}
			remove_variable = eu5ab_cmm_shift_step
			eu5ab_sync_cmm_settings = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__budget_mode
						var:cmf_callback = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__fixed_annual_budget
					}
				}
				eu5ab_refresh_global_budget = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# The GUI bridge variable is saved by the engine; do not reopen a window merely
# because the player saved while it was visible.
on_game_load_after_lobby_human_country = {
	on_actions = {
		eu5ab_on_cmf_after_load
	}
}

eu5ab_on_cmf_after_load = {
	effect = {
        if = { limit = { eu5ab_manual_month_current = yes } eu5ab_manual_recover = yes }
        else = {
		# No synchronous dispatcher survives a load. Retire the saved guard
		# here, before recovery; normal queue cleanup must preserve reentry protection.
		remove_variable = eu5ab_batch_running
		remove_variable = eu5ab_cmf_window_requested
		remove_variable = eu5ab_governor_window
		remove_variable = eu5ab_governor_window_requested
		set_variable = eu5ab_governor_dirty
		set_variable = eu5ab_naval_planner_dirty
		eu5ab_mark_interrupted_scan_on_load = yes
		eu5ab_recover_runtime_after_load = yes
		eu5ab_sync_cmm_settings = yes
		eu5ab_schedule_scan_resume_after_load = yes
		eu5ab_ensure_annual_budget = yes
	}
}
}

# Periodic refresh also catches expiring effects without native hooks.
on_road_construction_started = {
	on_actions = { eu5ab_governor_dirty_from_road }
}
on_road_construction_ended = {
	on_actions = { eu5ab_governor_dirty_from_road }
}
on_road_built = {
	on_actions = { eu5ab_governor_dirty_from_road }
}
eu5ab_governor_dirty_from_road = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { scope_type = country }
			if = {
				limit = { is_human = yes }
				set_variable = eu5ab_governor_dirty
		set_variable = eu5ab_naval_planner_dirty
			}
		}
	}
}
on_building_construction_started = {
	on_actions = { eu5ab_governor_dirty_from_building }
}
on_building_construction_ended = {
	on_actions = { eu5ab_governor_dirty_from_building }
}
on_building_built = {
	on_actions = { eu5ab_governor_dirty_from_building }
}
on_building_destroyed = {
	on_actions = { eu5ab_governor_dirty_from_building }
}
eu5ab_governor_dirty_from_building = {
	effect = {
		location ?= {
			owner ?= {
				if = { limit = { is_human = yes } set_variable = eu5ab_governor_dirty set_variable = eu5ab_naval_planner_dirty }
			}
		}
	}
}

on_location_changed_rank = {
	on_actions = { eu5ab_governor_dirty_from_location }
}

eu5ab_governor_dirty_from_location = {
	effect = {
		owner ?= {
			if = { limit = { is_human = yes } set_variable = eu5ab_governor_dirty
				set_variable = eu5ab_naval_planner_dirty }
		}
	}
}

# Append distinct callbacks without replacing vanilla/other mods' effects.
# Keep the country guard: reform notifications may use organization scope.
# Reform changes can batch identical notifications; mark dirty inline so the
# engine does not queue the same child on-action repeatedly.
on_capital_moved = {
	on_actions = { eu5ab_governor_dirty_on_capital_moved }
}
eu5ab_governor_dirty_on_capital_moved = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { scope_type = country }
			if = {
				limit = { is_human = yes }
				set_variable = eu5ab_governor_dirty
		set_variable = eu5ab_naval_planner_dirty
			}
		}
	}
}

	effect = {

				limit = { is_human = yes }
				set_variable = eu5ab_governor_dirty
		set_variable = eu5ab_naval_planner_dirty
			}
		}
	}
}
